text: This weekend, I built my personal portfolio website just to divert my mind a little and ended up spending hours on it. Bazinga! It’s now a home for my research, projects, publications, and open-source work in quantum communication, QKD, and photonics.

Glad to have participated in The Photonics Spectrum 2026, organized by NSUT Delhi Optica Student Chapter at Netaji Subhas University of Technology (NSUT), Delhi and sponsored by Optica. An insightful week exploring optics, photonics, and quantum communication.
Looking for a Quantum Communication Research Internship | Jan-Apr 2027 I’m looking for a research internship where I can work on Quantum Communication, QKD, TF-QKD, or FSO/satellite quantum links.

Happy to share a small research milestone. Our full-length paper, “Surrogate-Assisted Bayesian Optimization for Real-Time Parameter Adaptation in NPP-TF-QKD,” has been accepted for presentation at IEEE ANTS 2026, to be held at IIT Roorkee from 17–20 December…
Glad to share that I’ve successfully completed my summer research internship at Scientific Analysis Group, DRDO, Ministry of Defence, Govt. of India.

A meaningful milestone, but definitely not the end. I’ve completed my internship at Centre for Applied Research in Electronics, Indian Institute of Technology, Delhi, funded by IITM CDOT Samgnya Technologies Foundation, working under Prof. Neel Kanth Kundu on…

Excited to share a research milestone! Our paper, "Climatology-Aware Satellite Optical Channel Model for Slant-Path Propagation," has been accepted for presentation at the Optica 's 2026 Frontiers in Optics + Laser Science (FiOLS 2026) conference, to be held…

Came for the session, left with even more quantum curiosity. Prof. Bhaskar Kanseri's talk on Quantum Communication and QKD was fascinating, and the IIT Delhi - DRDO mission overview was equally exciting.

A few hours ago, I walked out of my last examination of second year. ✨ While most of my classmates were discussing answers and summer plans, I found myself thinking about everything that happened between the first day of second year and today.
Glad to contribute a book chapter to “Quantum Machine Learning: Concepts, Algorithms, and Applications” (Auerbach Publishers, 2026).

Back in December 2025, I had the opportunity to present my work, “Free-Space Optical QKD: Architecture, Integration, and Security Challenges,” at IEEE ANTS 2025, where it was featured as the opening presentation in Track A.
Looking back, this was my first step into research. My work was presented at SocProS 2025 (IIT Roorkee) and is now part of the Springer volume “Machine Learning and Its Applications to Healthcare.”
